sunnahs.quote: Do not belittle any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.
Allah loves gentleness in every matter.
Whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.
The best among you are those with the best character.

knowledge.intro: Short, grounded reminders for a thoughtful day.

cards.label: Generosity
cards.title: Charity does not diminish
cards.text: The Prophet ﷺ taught that charity does not diminish wealth. Even a small, regular act of support can nourish gratitude and care for people.

cards.label: Remembrance
cards.title: Begin the morning with dhikr
cards.text: The Qur’an calls believers to remember Allah often. A few quiet minutes of mindful dhikr can be a gentle anchor for the day.

cards.label: Night
cards.title: A quiet Tahajjud moment
cards.text: The voluntary night prayer is a chance to turn to Allah in private. Start small and do not turn voluntary worship into an unbearable burden.

settings.title: Settings & FAQ
settings.soundHint: Tones for dhikr, tabs, and milestones
settings.installHint: Use it like an app on your phone
settings.installedText: You are using the standalone app.
settings.serverRequiredText: A file opened directly from your computer cannot register a service worker, so a browser cannot install it as a PWA.
settings.serverStep1: Open the backend folder in a terminal.
settings.serverStep3: Open http://localhost:8080, then return here to install.
settings.readyInstallText: Install it for a full-screen, app-like experience.
settings.readyInstallStep: Use the Install now button below.
settings.iosInstallTitle: Add Nur to your Home Screen
settings.iosInstallText: Safari installs web apps from its Share menu.
settings.iosStep3: Choose Add to Home Screen, then Add.
settings.browserInstallText: If the native prompt is not ready yet, use your browser menu: Install app or Add to Home screen.
settings.browserStep1: Make sure the page is opened through HTTPS or localhost.
settings.browserStep2: Open the browser menu and choose Install app / Add to Home screen.
settings.browserStep3: If you just opened the page, wait a moment for the service worker to finish installing.
settings.exportHint: A private backup file on this device
settings.clearDataHint: This never affects published stories on your server
settings.clearConfirm: This removes only this browser’s Nur counter, saved practice history, and preferences. It cannot remove stories already sent to your server.
settings.privacy: Your counter and preferences stay in this browser. Stories are only sent after you deliberately submit the form.

items.a: Yes. The current count, goal, and dhikr stay only in this browser’s localStorage. Clearing site data removes them.

items.q: Can I use the app offline?
items.a: After its first visit, the interface and local tasbih work offline. Audio and the moderated story feed require internet.

items.q: Can the AI issue a fatwa?
items.a: No. The assistant is for reference only. For personal, complex, or disputed questions, consult a knowledgeable local imam.
Some questions have recognised differences among scholars and legal schools. The app does not choose an opinion for the user.
